card.name: Punctuation inside numbers and verse
card.fires_on: Separator marks (hyphen, comma, space, en dash) in the middle of a number or code, and line-ending punctuation in poem or hymn lines.

modes.label: Separator inside numbers
modes.description: A hyphen, comma, space or dash that splits a digit string such as a CAS number, phone number or table value.

modes.label: Punctuation in verse
modes.description: An exclamation mark or semicolon ending a line in a hymn or poem.
